outcome: need for antivirals, anticoagulants, and steroids
cohort: 3,791 pregnant women screened for COVID-19 infection during the first and second waves of the pandemic
finding: The incidence of COVID-19 infection was higher during the second wave (5.1%) compared to the first wave (4.2%), and the second wave was associated with more symptomatic cases and complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher during the second wave of COVID-19.
